newsitem.title: USA: Watson gets FDA approval letter for drug.
newsitem.headline: Watson gets FDA approval letter for drug.

text.p: Watson Pharmaceuticals Inc said Friday its wholly-owned subsidiary Watson Laboratories Inc had received an approvable letter from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its Microzide drug.
The company said Microzide would only be available in low-dose, 12.5 mg strength of the most commonly used thiazide diuretic, hydrochlorothiazide.
The drug is used for treating hypertension, it added.
Watson Pharmaceuticals, headquartered in Corona, Calif, is engaged in the manufacture and sale of off-patent medications and the development of proprietary pharmaceutical products.
